name: Manchester City
style: Possession-based positional play, midfield rebuild post-De Bruyne

tactical_patterns.build_up: Short passing from back, GK involved in build-up. Aït-Nouri overlaps, Gvardiol or Lewis inverts on opposite side. Rodri drops between CBs as single pivot. Reijnders provides dynamic ball progression. Progressive passing rate: 8.0 per 90 (FBref).
tactical_patterns.attacking: Half-space overloads with Foden left and Cherki/Bernardo right. Reijnders late runs replace De Bruyne's role. Width from FBs. Sustained possession (62% avg). xG per 90: 2.0 (FBref).
tactical_patterns.defensive: High press triggered by opponent GK or CB. Counter-press immediately on loss. PPDA: 8.6 (FBref). Compact midfield block when settled.
tactical_patterns.set_pieces: Cherki delivery from corners and free kicks. Haaland and Dias primary aerial targets. Set piece xG: 0.29 per match (FBref).
tactical_patterns.transitions: Quick vertical passes on turnover. Haaland stretches defensive line. Vulnerable to fast breaks when FBs are high — exposed in defeats vs Arsenal and Liverpool.

strengths: Restored midfield control post-De Bruyne via Reijnders + Cherki creativity (FBref)
Haaland clinical finishing (26 goals, +3.6 vs xG, FBref)
Squad depth — won EFL Cup, into FA Cup final
weaknesses: Slow start to season (no CL — failed to qualify from league phase)
Vulnerable to pace on counter-attacks (10 transition goals conceded, Football-Data.org)
Over-reliance on Rodri for midfield control
High defensive line exploitable with long balls behind
Cherki defensive work rate creates imbalance vs press-resistant teams

name: Real Madrid
style: Direct, transitional, star-driven (post-Alonso reset under Arbeloa)

tactical_patterns.build_up: Patient build-up through midfield. CBs split with Tchouaméni dropping. TAA inverts from RB to playmaker zone. Güler floats into half-spaces. Progressive passing rate: 7.4 per 90 (FBref).
tactical_patterns.attacking: Devastating transitions with Mbappé and Vinícius. Bellingham late arrivals in box. TAA crosses and switches from right. xG per 90: 2.1 (FBref).
tactical_patterns.defensive: Mid-block with compact shape (slightly more aggressive under Arbeloa). Press selectively on triggers. PPDA: 11.4 (FBref) — improved vs prior season but still passive.
tactical_patterns.set_pieces: Strong aerial threat from corners (Rüdiger, Bellingham, Huijsen). TAA delivery elite from right. Set piece xG: 0.30 per match (FBref).
tactical_patterns.transitions: Elite counter-attacking speed. Mbappé-Vinícius combination lethal on break. 16 transition goals this season (Football-Data.org).

strengths: Mbappé's historic season (41 goals all comps — top scorer in Europe, FBref)
Devastating pace on transitions (16 transition goals, top in La Liga)
TAA transformation of right-side build-up — 178 progressive passes (FBref)
Strong aerial presence from set pieces
weaknesses: Coaching turbulence — Alonso sacked 12 January after poor run
Defensive structure without the ball (PPDA 11.4 — still passive press)
Over-reliance on individual moments vs organized defenses
Midfield can be overrun by high-pressing teams (lost 4-1 to Barça, lost CL QF)
TAA defensive vulnerabilities exposed in transition

name: Liverpool
style: Possession-leaning press under Slot, Wirtz-led creative rebuild

tactical_patterns.build_up: GK distribution to FBs. Wirtz drops as 10 to receive between the lines. Frimpong inverts late. Gravenberch ball progression. Progressive passing rate: 8.6 per 90 (FBref — down from prior TAA-led season).
tactical_patterns.attacking: Wirtz-Salah right-side combinations. Ekitiké drops to link play. Kerkez overlaps on left. Direct passing into channels. xG per 90: 2.0 (FBref).
tactical_patterns.defensive: Aggressive high press in opponent's half (less intense than 24-25). Gegenpressing on loss. PPDA: 8.4 (FBref). Compact mid-block when press is beaten.
tactical_patterns.set_pieces: Szoboszlai delivery from corners. Van Dijk primary aerial target. Set piece xG: 0.32 per match (FBref).
tactical_patterns.transitions: Wirtz's progressive passing accelerates verticals. Salah and Ekitiké stretch play. Midfield runners support. 9 transition goals (Football-Data.org).

strengths: Wirtz creative engine (134 SCA, 9.8 xAG, FBref — Bundesliga form translating)
Ekitiké breakout season (17 goals all comps, top scorer)
Midfield balance — Gravenberch interceptions + Mac Allister progression
weaknesses: Disappointing 4th-place PL position vs defending champions expectations
Salah goal output dropped sharply (9 league goals vs 16+ prior)
Defensive transitions struggle with Frimpong + Kerkez both pushing high
Lost CL QF — knockout exit short of squad ambition
High line exploitable with pace behind (van Dijk recovery)

name: Arsenal
style: Structured possession, set-piece mastery, controlled aggression — leading PL title race

tactical_patterns.build_up: Structured build-up from back with Saliba/Gabriel split wide. Raya involved in short distribution. Zubimendi as deep pivot — best press-resistant midfielder Arsenal have had under Arteta. Timber inverts from RB. Progressive passing rate: 8.8 per 90 (FBref).
tactical_patterns.attacking: Saka-Ødegaard combination on right half-space remains primary creative axis. Eze provides creativity from left and AM. Gyökeres' aggressive runs in behind transformed Arsenal's vertical threat. xG per 90: 2.2 (FBref).
tactical_patterns.defensive: Medium-high press with selective triggers. PPDA: 8.4 (FBref). Compact 4-4-2 mid-block out of possession. Zubimendi screens passing lanes. Disciplined zonal marking.
tactical_patterns.set_pieces: Elite set-piece unit — Gabriel and Gyökeres primary aerial targets. Saka, Ødegaard, Eze delivery. 14 goals from set pieces this season (Football-Data.org). Set piece xG: 0.40 per match (FBref — highest in PL).
tactical_patterns.transitions: Gyökeres' direct running adds counter threat absent in prior seasons. Saka and Madueke can stretch on break. Recovery press within 5 seconds of loss.

strengths: Premier League leaders — top of the table heading into final stretch
Premier League's best set-piece unit (0.40 xG/match, 14 goals, FBref)
Gyökeres solved the centre-forward problem (21 goals all comps)
Zubimendi added elite press-resistant pivot (93% pass completion, FBref)
Saliba-Gabriel partnership (fewest big chances conceded in PL)
weaknesses: Saka-Ødegaard creative axis still essential — 31% xG drop without both
Lost CL semi-final — squad fatigue from European run a factor
Lost EFL Cup final — composure in finals questioned
Vulnerability on left side when Eze doesn't track back
Can become too structured — predictable in build-up against high press

name: FC Barcelona
style: High-pressing positional play, youth-driven intensity — La Liga leaders

tactical_patterns.build_up: Flick's positional play with high defensive line. CBs split wide, Casadó or de Jong as single pivot. Koundé inverts from RB. Short progressive passing through midfield triangles. Progressive passing rate: 9.6 per 90 (FBref — highest in La Liga).
tactical_patterns.attacking: Yamal and Raphinha stretch width; Rashford rotates with Raphinha on left. Pedri and Olmo occupy half-spaces. Lewandowski holds and combines in zone 14. Overloads right half-space via Yamal-Koundé-Pedri triangle. xG per 90: 2.5 (FBref).
tactical_patterns.defensive: Extremely high press — Flick's signature. PPDA: 6.2 (FBref — most aggressive in La Liga). High defensive line (avg 48m from goal). Immediate counter-press on loss — 4-second recovery rule.
tactical_patterns.set_pieces: Lewandowski and Araújo primary targets. Raphinha and Olmo delivery. Set piece xG: 0.27 per match (FBref). Near-post flick routines from corners.
tactical_patterns.transitions: Ultra-fast vertical transitions on turnover. Yamal's pace stretches defenses immediately. Rashford makes diagonal counter-runs from left. 14 transition goals this season (Football-Data.org).

strengths: La Liga and Supercopa winners — domestic dominance under Flick
Most aggressive press in La Liga (PPDA 6.2, FBref)
Yamal generational season — 14 goals + 9.8 xAG at 18 years old
Highest progressive passing rate in La Liga (9.6 per 90, FBref)
Rashford loan refreshed left flank — added pace and 2-footed threat
weaknesses: Extremely high defensive line exploitable with pace behind (10 goals on through balls, Football-Data.org)
Defensive vulnerability from set pieces (8 set-piece goals conceded — worst in La Liga top 4)
Camp Nou return mid-season disrupted home rhythm
Reliance on individual brilliance when structured play is disrupted

name: Paris Saint-Germain
style: Possession-dominant, positional play, high press — defending European champions

tactical_patterns.build_up: Luis Enrique's positional play — patient build-up with GK in possession. Hakimi pushes high, Nuno Mendes provides width. Vitinha as primary ball progressor from midfield. 3-2 build-up shape (one FB tucks in). Progressive passing rate: 9.0 per 90 (FBref).
tactical_patterns.attacking: Width from Dembélé (right/central) and Kvaratskhelia/Barcola (left). Doué rotates into half-spaces. Vitinha and Joao Neves make third-man runs. Half-space overloads via midfielder rotations. xG per 90: 2.4 (FBref).
tactical_patterns.defensive: High press with aggressive triggers — 70%+ possession reduces defensive exposure. PPDA: 7.4 (FBref). Counter-press immediately on loss. Back four holds high line (avg 46m from goal).
tactical_patterns.set_pieces: Marquinhos and Pacho primary targets from corners. Vitinha and Kvaratskhelia delivery. Set piece xG: 0.26 per match (FBref). Zonal marking defensively.
tactical_patterns.transitions: Devastating pace on break through Dembélé, Barcola, Kvaratskhelia and Hakimi. 3v2 counter-attacks frequent. 15 transition goals this season (Football-Data.org).

strengths: Defending European champions — won 2024-25 UCL final
Dembélé Ballon d'Or season (28 goals all comps — career-best)
Kvaratskhelia + Doué deepened attacking depth post-Mbappé
Elite ball progression — Vitinha 188 progressive passes (FBref)
Luis Enrique's possession control (67% avg — top in Europe)
weaknesses: High line exploitable with direct balls behind (9 through-ball goals, Football-Data.org)
Set-piece defending remains a liability (7 set-piece goals conceded)
Heavy fixture load post-Club World Cup taxed squad freshness
Over-possession can become sterile vs organized low blocks (xG drops to 1.2)
Chevalier still adapting to elite knockout pressure

name: Bayern Munich
style: High-pressing, vertical transitions, wide overloads — Bundesliga champions, CL semi-finalists

tactical_patterns.build_up: GK plays short to CBs. Kimmich drops as single pivot between CBs. FBs push high — Davies provides width on left, Laimer overlaps on right. Progressive passing rate: 9.4 per 90 (FBref). Tah carries ball aggressively from back.
tactical_patterns.attacking: Wide overloads with Davies overlapping and Olise/Díaz cutting inside. Musiala operates between the lines in left half-space when fit. Kane drops deep to link play then attacks box. xG per 90: 2.5 (FBref). High crossing volume from wide areas (19.2 per 90).
tactical_patterns.defensive: Aggressive high press — PPDA: 7.0 (FBref, lowest in Bundesliga). Gegenpressing within 5 seconds of loss. Compact 4-4-2 mid-block when press is bypassed. Vulnerable in transition when FBs are caught high.
tactical_patterns.set_pieces: Kane and Olise as primary delivery. Tah and Upamecano as aerial targets. Near-post flick routines. Set piece xG: 0.30 per match (FBref).
tactical_patterns.transitions: Lightning counter-attacks via Davies' pace on left or Díaz's direct running. Kane as target man for long transitions. Dangerous in 3v3 / 4v4 fast breaks.

strengths: Bundesliga champions — reclaimed title from Leverkusen
Kane historic season (54 goals all comps — Bundesliga golden boot, FBref)
Most aggressive press in Bundesliga (PPDA 7.0, FBref)
Olise creative explosion (138 SCA, 12.8 xAG, FBref)
Reached CL semi-finals — squad ready for European challenge
weaknesses: Defensive transition vulnerability when both FBs are high (12 transition goals conceded, Football-Data.org)
Musiala injury disruption affected creative depth in mid-season
Set-piece defending — zonal marking leaves gaps at back post
Over-reliance on Kimmich in build-up — pressing him disrupts rhythm
Neuer's age-related decline in shot stopping (psxG-GA only +2.6)
